card.name: Route words in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: The start of route-of-administration words written in capitals, such as IN in INJECTION, INTRAMUSCULAR, INTRAVENOUS and INTRATHECAL, or AV in INTRAVENOUS. It fires mostly in all-caps label warnings.

modes.label: IN before route words
modes.description: The capital piece IN that begins INJECTION, INTRAMUSCULAR, INTRAVENOUS or INTRATHECAL.
modes.example: THIS PRODUCT IS FOR INTRAVENOUS OR<< IN>>TRAMUSCULAR ADMINISTRATION ONLY

modes.label: AV inside INTRAVENOUS
modes.description: The AV piece in the middle of INTRAVENOUS in capitalized warnings.
modes.example: DO NOT ADMINISTER VIA AN INTR<<AV>>ENOUS PUSH.

modes.label: DE in DEATH
modes.description: The DE piece starting DEATH in a capitalized boxed warning.
